overall.verdict: Light mobile has a clear total, a real bilateral notch, and honest Hub One math, but it does not ship: 1 px = $10 is contradicted by faded duplicate bars and a 2.5 px payment mark, and receipts disagree with themselves. A stale send toast, Home-selected tabs on Pay/Receive/Swap, a 0.00 swap quote, and sandbox/debug settings keep it below a calm fintech bar.
priority_fixes: Honor 1 px = $10 with hard clips, no end-fades; delete the Home tier legend, the duplicate USDC composition bar, and the Pay 'This payment' 2.5 px bullet
One committed receipt: kill the sticky 'Payment submitted' toast on Receipt/Receive/Swap; unify PAID vs submitted and Frame #41 vs #42; human time, no 2683 ms
Hide the tab bar (or deselect Home) on Pay/Receive/Swap; truncate hex; one copy action on Receive
Swap must never show You receive 0.00 without a reason; move network switching out of the navbar and take sandbox off the token chip
Fix overflow chrome: Activity 'Accou' chip, Settings $1000 chip, Account legend that does not match the bar, Reveal recovery phrase as a confirm sheet
